note: XXV cues 76–78 fills · Booth style · 24–25 Oct 1893, full moon
style: An oil painting in colour of 1893 with the drama of Franklin Booth: monumental scale, deep recession, strong value contrast, deep shadow. Moonlit night, cool silver-blue moonlight from a full moon, warm lamplight in windows only. Loose visible brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges. No text, signature or border.

beats.text: Shot: very wide, exterior. The Black Sea port of Varna, Bulgaria, at night on 24 October 1893 under a full moon high over the sea: an old hotel on the waterfront with a few lit upper windows, the harbour below with ships at anchor, low houses and a minaret, moonlight on the water.

Shot: medium-wide interior, no people. A hotel room in Varna at night in 1893: a writing desk under a tall window, an open leather diary with a steel pen and inkstand, an oil lamp, moonlight from the window falling across the floor, the harbour masts outside.

Shot: far interior. One o’clock in the morning in a high hotel room in Varna, 1893: four men small and dark against a tall window, waiting, looking out at the moonlit harbour, coats on, a single lamp turned low, their faces not seen.

Shot: close, no people. On a table by a window in noon light, a great curved Gurkha kukri knife in its dark leather scabbard half drawn, a whetstone and a cloth beside it, its edge catching a cold line of daylight, deep shadow around.
